summary: Frontend-only verification of DOB age check + www->apex redirect code. All 7 requested checks pass on preview https://birthday-picker-1.preview.emergentagent.com/login. Year list now spans current year (2026) down to 1906 (121 entries). Too-young message shows immediately for years within last 12 (e.g. 2021), and for exactly-under-13 (tomorrow's day/month, year=2013); hides for year 2000 and for exactly-13-today. Leap-year day clamping still works: Feb 2000 max day=29, switching to 2001 clamps 29->28. With too-young DOB plus name/email/password, clicking 'Create account' is blocked by native validity (setCustomValidity on year select) and NO /register network request is sent. /app/index.html head contains a script that redirects location.hostname==='www.skaliapp.com' to https://skaliapp.com preserving pathname+search+hash; preview host is not affected.

issues: Browser's native validation tooltip for setCustomValidity partially overlays the inline amber too-young message, causing minor duplicate messaging on submit. Non-blocking - both messages are consistent.

critical_code_review_comments: DobPicker useEffect that clamps day has deps [maxDay] only (missing d); works but ESLint exhaustive-deps would warn. Non-blocking.
www->apex redirect uses location.replace which is correct; condition is strict hostname match so no risk of over-matching subdomains like preview.emergentagent.com.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL serves root Vite via /app frontend. Register DOB testIds: register-dob-{day|month|year}-select, warning: register-dob-too-young-msg. Year list = thisYear..thisYear-120. Too-young triggers when thisYear-y<13 or full-dob age<13. Native setCustomValidity on year select blocks form submission; no register network request fires. Current year during test: 2026.
